description.value:
Demolition as mercy — remove the blade, not the patient.

Level 3: Non-Lethal Blast (BBTTCC)

Explosives can be set to subdue sentients; success grants **+1 Non-Lethal OP** (once/scenario).

Level 3: Patient Charges

Advantage to plant charges unnoticed or shape a blast to protect non-combatants.

Level 6: Shock Net

Fringe creatures Dex save or restrained in debris until end of next turn.

Level 10: Rescue Lane

Create an opening: allies passing through gain +10 ft and ignore OAs this turn.

Level 14: Silence the Boom

1/long rest, demolition is silent beyond 60 ft and doesn’t trigger sound alarms.
